- scripts/render_prompt.sh:92-307 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The PR removes the documented `UNATTENDED_IDENTITY_REINJECT_ENABLED` identity-recall injection path and its helper functions from the prompt renderer.
  WHY: Reviewers described this as a MAJOR/BLOCKER regression of an already-documented feature, so severity is set to critical; the reviewers disagreed only on how strongly to label it.
- scripts/render_prompt.sh:240-242 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: `cleanup_assembled_prompt` only cleans the last assembled prompt temp file, so earlier `.assembled.*` files can leak across multiple renders.
  WHY: Both reviewers reported temp-file leakage; one called it a NIT and the other a MAJOR maintenance/runtime issue, so severity is set to low with the noted disagreement.
- scripts/render_prompt.sh:240 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The assembled prompt temp file is now created under `${PROMPT_ROOT_DIR}` instead of `${TMPDIR:-/tmp}`.
  WHY: This regresses prompt rendering in environments where the prompts directory is not writable.
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:22-41 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: Removing the `emit_event` sourcing/stub block means scripts that source `gh_helpers.sh` no longer get a safe `emit_event` definition.
  WHY: Reviewers reported command-not-found failures for callers and loss of structured JSONL mirroring; severity is critical because reviewers called it MAJOR/BLOCKER.
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:1236-1244 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The `AUTOFIX_PEER_CHECK` event is no longer mirrored to the JSONL events file.
  WHY: Reviewers disagreed between NIT and BLOCKER, but both described the same telemetry regression, so severity is set to critical.
- scripts/semble_helpers.sh:4-42 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: `_semble_log_event` no longer mirrors `SEMBLE_QUERY` and `SEMBLE_FALLBACK` events to JSONL.
  WHY: This removes the structured telemetry path while leaving only stderr text logs; reviewers called it MAJOR/BLOCKER.
- scripts/setup_serena.sh:19-59 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: `emit_serena_fallback` no longer mirrors `SERENA_FALLBACK` events to JSONL.
  WHY: This is the same structured-telemetry regression reviewers labeled MAJOR/BLOCKER.
- scripts/mcp_handshake_probe.py:10-128 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: `_emit_probe_line` no longer mirrors `SERENA_PROBE` events to JSONL.
  WHY: The stderr probe line remains, but the structured event is removed; reviewers consistently rated this as MAJOR/BLOCKER.
- scripts/serena_stats_emit.py:11-143 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: `emit_rollups()` no longer mirrors `SERENA_QUERY` events to JSONL.
  WHY: This drops structured telemetry while preserving only text output, which reviewers treated as a major/blocker regression.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:84-192 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: `_log_semble_event` no longer mirrors `SEMBLE_QUERY` and `SEMBLE_FALLBACK` events to JSONL.
  WHY: Same telemetry-contract break as the other mirror removals; reviewers rated it MAJOR/BLOCKER.
- scripts/stage_workflow_support.sh:114-142 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: The new `transcript_archive.sh` loop was inserted at the same indentation level as the surrounding loop body, which the reviewer believed breaks loop scoping/termination.
  WHY: This was reported as a possible runtime-control-flow issue, not just a style nit, so severity is kept at the reviewer’s MAJOR level.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:16882-16896 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The judge-success block and `archive_transcript` call use hard-tabs while surrounding code uses spaces.
  WHY: Reviewers agreed this is inconsistent and confusing, but not a runtime bug; severity is set to low.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:16888-16891 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: `archive_transcript` was placed in the failure block after `continue`, so judge transcripts would be archived on failure instead of on the success path.
  WHY: One reviewer reported the call in the wrong branch while others focused on indentation/style, so severity follows the blocker report and the disagreement is noted.
- scripts/transcript_archive.sh:61-63, 109-112 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The Python `fail()` path exits with `SystemExit(0)`, making the shell `$?` failure branch unreachable.
  WHY: Reviewers disagreed on whether this is merely dead code or a major observability regression, but all agreed archive failures can be swallowed silently.
- scripts/transcript_archive.sh:48-53 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: `source_path` is accepted and read without any workspace-boundary check.
  WHY: This is a defense gap if a future caller ever passes user-controlled input.
- agents.md:534 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: `LOG_PREFIX.name=TRANSCRIPT_ARCHIVE_FAIL` appears twice in the stable-prefix list.
  WHY: Reviewers treated this as a cosmetic but contract-breaking duplicate in the registry.
- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:4174,2139 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: Slop-scan residuals report invalid `python_heredoc` continuation lines in `orchestrate_poll_process.sh` and `validate_process.sh`.
  WHY: This was reported as a CI/lint cleanliness issue rather than a functional break.

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/render_prompt.sh:Lines ~95-285 removed (identity-recall injection block: resolve_identity_recall_template, resolve_identity_source_prompt, resolve_identity_phase_name, extract_identity_recall_metadata, render_identity_recall_block, inject_identity_recall_block, cleanup_temp_files, emit_identity_reinject_parse_fail functions), lines ~227-260 modified (identity-recall conditional block removed, cleanup_trap replaced, mktemp path changed, final guard changed) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The PR removes ~190 lines of Phase B identity-recall injection logic (`UNATTENDED_IDENTITY_REINJECT_ENABLED` code path) in a Phase A-only change.
  WHY: Any consumer repo that has `UNATTENDED_IDENTITY_REINJECT_ENABLED=true` gets silent no-op instead of identity-recall injection.
- scripts/render_prompt.sh:Line 240 (`ASSEMBLED_PROMPT_FILE="$(mktemp "${PROMPT_ROOT_DIR}/.${PROMPT_BASENAME}.assembled.XXXXXX")"`), line 242 (`trap cleanup_assembled_prompt EXIT`) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The EXIT trap was changed from `cleanup_temp_files` to `cleanup_assembled_prompt`, so earlier `.assembled.*` temp files can leak.
  WHY: Multiple prompt renders in the same job leave stale `.assembled.*` temp files in the prompts directory.
- scripts/render_prompt.sh:Line 240 (`mktemp "${PROMPT_ROOT_DIR}/.${PROMPT_BASENAME}.assembled.XXXXXX"`) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The assembled prompt temp file path was changed from `${TMPDIR:-/tmp}` to `${PROMPT_ROOT_DIR}`.
  WHY: Prompt rendering can fail in CI environments where the prompts directory is not writable.
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:Lines 25-41 removed (emit_event sourcing and stub block) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The safe fallback definition of `emit_event` was removed from `gh_helpers.sh`.
  WHY: Callers that source `gh_helpers.sh` and then invoke `emit_event` without separately sourcing `emit_event.sh` will hit `command not found`.
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:Lines 1236-1244 removed (emit_event "AUTOFIX_PEER_CHECK" call from autofix_retrigger_has_inflight_peer) | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The `AUTOFIX_PEER_CHECK` event is no longer mirrored to the JSONL events file when `EVENTS_JSONL_ENABLED=true`.
  WHY: Downstream JSONL-consuming tooling loses the structured peer-check telemetry.
- scripts/semble_helpers.sh:Lines 4-18 removed (emit_event sourcing), lines 21-23 removed (emit_fields array), line 42 removed (emit_event call in _semble_log_event) | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `_semble_log_event` no longer mirrors `SEMBLE_QUERY` and `SEMBLE_FALLBACK` events to JSONL.
  WHY: Structured event consumers lose the SEMBLE signal.
- scripts/setup_serena.sh:Lines 22-32 removed (emit_event sourcing), lines 56-58 removed (emit_event "SERENA_FALLBACK" calls in emit_serena_fallback) | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `emit_serena_fallback` no longer mirrors `SERENA_FALLBACK` events to JSONL.
  WHY: JSONL consumers lose the fallback event.
- scripts/mcp_handshake_probe.py:Lines 13-21 removed (_emit_event_helper import + _mirror_event function), lines 104-128 simplified (_emit_probe_line no longer calls _mirror_event for SERENA_PROBE) | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `_emit_probe_line` no longer mirrors `SERENA_PROBE` events to the JSONL events file.
  WHY: Structured `SERENA_PROBE` events are absent from JSONL when `EVENTS_JSONL_ENABLED=true`.
- scripts/serena_stats_emit.py:Lines 14-22 removed (_emit_event_helper import + _mirror_event function), lines 135-143 removed (_mirror_event("SERENA_QUERY", ...) call in emit_rollups) | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `emit_rollups` no longer mirrors `SERENA_QUERY` events to JSONL.
  WHY: Structured `SERENA_QUERY` events are absent from JSONL.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:Lines 87-95 removed (_emit_event_helper import + _mirror_event function), line 192 removed (_mirror_event call in _log_semble_event) | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `_log_semble_event` no longer mirrors `SEMBLE_QUERY/SEMBLE_FALLBACK` events to JSONL.
  WHY: Structured `SEMBLE` events are absent from JSONL.
- scripts/transcript_archive.sh:Lines 61-63 (Python heredoc fail() function uses raise SystemExit(0)), lines 109-112 (shell `if [ "$?" -ne 0 ]` guard after heredoc) | severity=NIT | confidence=5

  WHY: Archive I/O or JSON errors are silently swallowed instead of reaching the shell logging branch.
